Fresh 30-day Developer scratch org from a campaign Dev Hub with the LiveAgent and LiveMessage feature settings in scratch-def.json. Anonymous describe at API 62.0 and 67.0 reports whether MessagingSession.CampaignId is present. The org was deleted; a unique description matched exactly one Dev Hub ScratchOrgInfo record with Status Deleted.
 A separate fresh 30-day scratch org captured anonymous and @IsTest membership at every API from 62.0 through 67.0 (versions.tsv). It was deleted; a unique description matched exactly one Dev Hub ScratchOrgInfo record with Status Deleted.
 A third fresh 30-day scratch org captured anonymous field describe facets at 66.0 and 67.0 (facets.tsv); it was deleted and exact unique-description ScratchOrgInfo verified Deleted.
 A fourth fresh 30-day scratch org captured @IsTest field describe facets at 66.0 and 67.0 (facets-istest.tsv); they match the anonymous rows. It was deleted and exact unique-description ScratchOrgInfo verified Deleted.
 A fifth fresh 30-day scratch org captured named valid/invalid compile, anonymous compile, dynamic query and REST describe routes at API 62, 65, 66 and 67 (routes.tsv); it was deleted and exact unique-description ScratchOrgInfo verified Deleted. Dynamic query succeeded even where the field was absent from describe.
 A sixth fresh 30-day scratch org captured named static-query compilation and anonymous dynamic-query execution at every API 62.0 through 67.0 (query-versions.tsv); it was deleted and exact unique-description ScratchOrgInfo verified Deleted.
 A seventh fresh 30-day scratch org deployed a synthetic custom field and captured named declared/missing field compilation at 62.0 and 67.0 (custom-fields.tsv). It was deleted and exact unique-description ScratchOrgInfo verified Deleted.
